description: Use this when you want exact, auditable percentage math with a written-out formula. Three modes: "of" computes percent% of value (fields percent, value); "is-what" computes what percent x is of y (fields x, y; y must be non-zero); "change" computes the percent change from -> to (from must be non-zero) and reports direction as "increase" or "decrease". Returns the numeric result plus a human-readable formula string. Deterministic: same input, same output. Example: mode="change", from=200, to=250 -> result=25, direction="increase".

from.description: (mode "change") The starting value; must be non-zero.

mode.description: Which calculation to perform. "of" = percent% of value; "is-what" = x is what percent of y; "change" = percent change from -> to.

percent.description: (mode "of") The percentage to apply, e.g. 15 for 15%.

value.description: (mode "of") The base value that the percentage is taken of.

y.description: (mode "is-what") The whole value; must be non-zero.

name: percentage

direction.description: (change mode only) Whether the change was an increase (result >= 0) or a decrease.

formula.description: Human-readable statement of what was computed, e.g. "15% of 80".

percent.description: (is-what and change modes) The percent, equal to result; present alongside result for those two modes.

result.description: The numeric answer: the computed amount (of), or the percent (is-what, change). May be negative for a decrease.

title: Percentage Calculator
